prompt: Accounts need passwords. Add `register(&mut self, email: &str, password: &str)` and `log_in(&self, email: &str, password: &str) -> bool` to `AccountService` in src/service.rs. Hash with `kdf::derive` from src/kdf.rs and a salt from `kdf::random_salt`; never store the password itself. `build_service` in src/app.rs must keep returning a ready service.
